episodes.title: Emotional Beat
episodes.summary: Tomoro Tenma lives in a world where human thoughts and emotions—known as "e-Pulse"—power AI devices called Sapotama. But when Digimon begin materializing from Sapotama and feeding on e-Pulse, society begins to fracture. After Gekkomon appears from his device, Tomoro joins Glowing Dawn, a secret team investigating rogue Digimon and the dark truth of a system both fueled and corrupted by emotion.

episodes.title: Glowing Dawn
episodes.summary: Gekkomon is awakened by Tomoro's anger and overwhelms his enemy. Just then, a mysterious Digimon steals their Sapotama. With his brother lost, Tomoro shuts down emotionally, until he is shocked by what the leader of the ""Glowing Dawn"" has to say.

episodes.title: Facing Mirrors
episodes.summary: Tomoro Tenma and his Digimon Gekkomon join the bounty hunters Golden Dawn to investigate rogue Digimon.

episodes.title: Family
episodes.summary: Tomoro Tenma and his Digimon Gekkomon join the bounty hunters Golden Dawn to investigate rogue Digimon.

episodes.title: Half and Half
episodes.summary: Tomoro Tenma and his Digimon Gekkomon join the bounty hunters Golden Dawn to investigate rogue Digimon.

episodes.title: The Bond of Parent and Child
episodes.summary: Tomoro Tenma and his Digimon Gekkomon join the bounty hunters Golden Dawn to investigate rogue Digimon.

episodes.title: Nirinso
episodes.summary: Tomoro and the others find hikers who've nearly fallen victim to Cold Heart. They are saved by an exhausted Kyo and Murasamemon. Deep in the mountain is an old observatory that holds Kyo's secret.

episodes.title: The Vanishing Classroom
episodes.summary: Hitomi takes Tomoro to school to investigate a series of student disappearances. Only the top students are going missing. Gekkomon struggles to rescue Tomoro when he's trapped inside Mimicmon.

episodes.title: Utopia
episodes.summary: Going after a bounty, the Glowing Dawn infiltrate Shangri-La Egg, a utopia created after a massive disaster. There, other Cleaners who are also after Goldnumemon appear in front of Tomoro and the others…

episodes.title: A True Friend
episodes.summary: Chiropmon is taken from Makoto by Haruko, who sees Digimon as toys. Kyo tries to interrupt the buyer's transaction, while Makoto feels troubled because his own weakness caused Chiropmon to suffer.

episodes.title: A Black Emotion
episodes.summary: While out buying a birthday present for Asuka, Tomoro gets into a fight with Gekkomon over picking a scarf. Separated from Tomoro, the sulking Gekkomon encounters a Digimon who emits poisonous gas.

episodes.title: A New Family
episodes.summary: Tomoro Tenma and his Digimon Gekkomon join the bounty hunters Golden Dawn to investigate rogue Digimon.

episodes.title: Five Star Meeting
episodes.summary: The Five Stars, who stand at the top of the Cleaner world, gather for a meeting. The topic is the increase in Cold Heart incidents and emerging disaster-class Digimon. Meanwhile, Tomoro and the others encounter a strange trio at a crime site.

episodes.title: Tactics
episodes.summary: The Tactics are Cleaner teams that undergo rigorous training to perfect e-Pulse control. The Glowing Dawn members face off against them over a bounty, but Tomoro can't accept their methods.

episodes.title: Little Courage
episodes.summary: The Kinoko Gang, holding a grudge, sneak into Nirinso while Kyo is away, aiming to destroy the Glowing Dawn. Redvegimon paralyzes Gekkomon and the others, while the In-Training Digimon can only watch…

episodes.title: Where I Belong
episodes.summary: Granit's interference causes Reina to let her target escape, and they are both taken to a cold, snowy mountain by Moosemon. While they look for clues to go back, Granit recalls the birth of Ludomon.

episodes.title: Antipathy
episodes.summary: While pursuing a Koemon, the Glowing Dawn encounter the Tactics.

episodes.title: The Price of Freedom
episodes.summary: Tomoro and the others treat a man who collapsed outside their headquarters to stew.

episodes.title: Black Market Auction
episodes.summary: Tomoro and the others infiltrate an illegal Digimon auction held by Five Star member Klay Arslan. While investigating the venue which is being guarded by Tactics, they find a girl and her Tinkermon locked in a cage.

episodes.title: Proof of Genius
episodes.summary: Tomoro gets kidnapped by a monkey Digimon and wakes up in an arena inside the Mirror World, where Digimon Owners are forced to fight. After Tomoro wins his first match, his next opponent appears to be Raito.

episodes.title: The One Beside You
episodes.summary: The members of Glowing Dawn rush to Tomoro's aid. Tomoro descends beneath the colosseum to rescue Raito who was taken away. Naito and his team intercept Kyo, but Reina suddenly notices something wrong with Granit…

episodes.title: Defiance
episodes.summary: Naito relentlessly targets Kyo to fulfill Klay's wish. Meanwhile, Hotaruko is troubled by her orders to eliminate the traitor. Then, the Five Stars Star of Water, Honoka the Abyssal appears and declares that she has come to hunt down the Tactics.

episodes.title: The Power to Take
episodes.summary: Tomoro and the others head to the colosseum to rescue those who've been Cold-Hearted.

episodes.title: Overlapping Beats
episodes.summary: Tomoro fights Klay to save Kyo, but he's helpless against Klay's overwhelming power, and his family gets injured. Consumed by his anger, Tomoro becomes reckless. Then, the genius he once defeated shows up…

episodes.title: Half-baked Hero
episodes.summary: On the way back to their headquarters, Tomoro and the others take a short vacation on a luxury cruise ship.

episodes.title: The Taste of Guilt
episodes.summary: Haruomi is found collapsed outside Nirinso. Rescued by Kyo, he is reunited with Commandramon and then runs into a weakened Elizamon. On Gekkomon's suggestion, the two Digimon settle their battle to be Haruomi's partner through a cooking competition.

episodes.title: Wandering Love
episodes.summary: Hitomi runs into Tomoro after a long time, but she's acting strange. Due to a mysterious wrapping on her arm, Tomoro and the others begin showing strong affection for their Digimon. The Digimon escape and ask Maki for help…

episodes.title: Gift
episodes.summary: Tomoro meets a mysterious girl while visiting Asuka. Meanwhile, the Glowing Dawn head to the hospital to catch a serial killer. There, they find a Digimon with a strange interest in deliveries, and an Owner infatuated with Digimon.

episodes.title: Dangerous Fandom
episodes.summary: In order to investigate a Digimon incident, Reina infiltrates popular actor Urato's fan event.

episodes.title: Wings to Protect You
episodes.summary: The Glowing Dawn visit Shangri-La Egg again at the request of the CEO of Kuonji Industries. Makoto and Chiropmon look uneasy as they listen to Tsukasa, Makoto's hospitalized twin brother. During their investigation, the true motive of the culprit is revealed…

episodes.title: One Step Forward
episodes.summary: Tomoro meets a reclusive girl accompanied by a Digimon on the beach. Maki has an urgent request and tells the Glowing Dawn about a very dangerous Digimon in the bay area. Meanwhile, two Cleaners appear and approach the girl…

episodes.title: Cold Rain
episodes.summary: GIFT is responsible for several information brokers getting Cold Hearted.

episodes.title: Midsummer Ghost
episodes.summary: Tomoro and the others visit a beach hut run by Hotaruko. While enjoying Shakomon's specialty dish, they spot Raito and Monodramon passed out on the beach. Raito brushes them off and leaves, but someone is watching from the shadows.

episodes.title: Behind the Mask
episodes.summary: Tomoro devises a plan and catches a serial kidnapper.

episodes.title: Rampaging Instinct
episodes.summary: Reina and Pristimon train hard to prove Rose wrong. Meanwhile, GIFT is orchestrating a series of bombings targeting World Union-related facilities. Feeling anxious, Reina loses focus and the culprit gets away, leaving her feeling discouraged.

episodes.title: Twisted Code
episodes.summary: GIFT have kidnapped Chairman Wong and start a world-wide countdown for their true objective.

episodes.title: Kind Magic
episodes.summary: Tomoro, Rose and the others enter the GIFT base. Miharu takes control of Shangri-La Egg's systems, taking the residents hostage, to pressure Chairman Wong into revealing the existence of Digimon. When questioned, Miharu brings up Chifuyu's wish…

episodes.title: Hollow Thirst
episodes.summary: Tomoro and the others secretly prepare a party for Kyo, who spends a peaceful time reaffirming their family ties. Meanwhile, Kawarazaki receives a report of a man who escaped from prison by using a Digimon.

episodes.title: Lip Service
episodes.summary: Meto and Kanon attack the Glowing Dawn, looking for Kyo Sawashiro. Meanwhile, at Nirinso, Souji Kuroshio attempts to quench his thirst by threatening to destroy everything Kyo treasures, demanding Kyo return to his old self.

episodes.title: Unfading Night
episodes.summary: Tomoro Tenma and his Digimon Gekkomon join the bounty hunters Golden Dawn to investigate rogue Digimon.

episodes.title: A Golden Tomorrow
episodes.summary: Tomoro and the others find themselves struggling against Souji's three Ultimate Digimon.

episodes.title: Sakura Friendship
episodes.summary: Kyo joins Tomoro on a hospital visit to see Asuka for the first time in a while. On the way, Kyo shares his memories of Asuka which were unknown to Tomoro. Within them lies the hidden truth behind the birth of Cougarmon.

episodes.title: The White Digimon
episodes.summary: Tomoro is shocked by Asuka's sudden appearance with a Digimon partner. Meanwhile Kishiwada arrives at Apraxas, after having been appointed as the new Star of Earth. The final piece needed to complete the Shangri-La Project is…

episodes.title: The Strongest Man
episodes.summary: Kyo and the others rush to rescue Tomoro when Kaito appears, intent on settling a score. They split up, and Reina faces Honoka, while Makoto fights Kishiwada. Kaito, seeking to be the strongest, smirks as a fierce pulse wraps Flaremon in light…

episodes.title: Big Brother, Little Brother
episodes.summary: Tomoro resolves to bring Asuka back, so with his family he confronts Heliosboamon. Suddenly, Kanada and Gokuwmon show up and force Tomoro onto the defensive, but what is their real motive…?
